NYSE.note: NYSE publishes 2026-2028 on its holiday page. The dataset includes those years.

Nasdaq.note: exchange_calendars XNAS and pandas_market_calendars NASDAQ are aliases of the NYSE calendar classes. There is no distinct Nasdaq implementation.

CME.note: Dataset base is exchange_calendars CMES (alias CME). pandas_market_calendars has no single CME calendar. CME_Equity and CME Globex Equity are the native calendars used for comparison.

HKEX.note: Severe-weather rows are typed as typhoon_* only when an HKEX notice was fetched.

SSE.note: exchange_calendars records XSHG holidays only through 2026. 2027 is omitted.

JPX.note: Tokyo Stock Exchange cash market (TSE), calendar code XTKS / JPX.

KRX.note: pandas_market_calendars XKRX is a mirror of exchange_calendars, so agreement is not a second source. 2027 projections are omitted.

open_items: KRX has no parsed official holiday list. open.krx.co.kr and the KIND market calendar returned page shells without dates. pandas_market_calendars XKRX is a mirror of exchange_calendars, so every KRX row is unverified. 2027 and later are omitted: the exchange announces that year around December, and library projections through 2050 were not copied.

KRX late opens (first business day of the year, and CSAT days, at 10:00 KST) come from exchange_calendars special offsets. The late_opens property on that calendar is empty even when the schedule open is 10:00. The pandas_market_calendars mirror shows 09:00. CSAT rows also shift the close (16:00 before 2016-08-01, 16:30 after). The last non-January late open in the 2001-2026 schedule is 2020-12-03; 2021-2026 have only the January late open. Those rows are unverified.

SSE 2027 is omitted. exchange_calendars 4.13.2 refuses dates after 2026. pandas_market_calendars SSE documents its post-2026 rules as guesses and those guesses were not copied. 2024-2026 weekday closures that match the fetched SSE pages are official.

CME is not one calendar. The dataset uses exchange_calendars CMES. Native pandas_market_calendars CME_Equity and CME Globex Equity disagree on some full closures (several Good Fridays) and on early-close sets; disagreed rows are unverified. The CME Group holiday page is product-specific and was not parsed into session rows. 2001-09-11 through 2001-09-14 are sessions in CMES and in both native CME calendars.

Nasdaq is not an independent calendar in either library (alias of NYSE / XNYS), so agreement between the libraries is not a second source. Only the 2026 Nasdaq Trader holiday page was fetched, so only 2026 Nasdaq rows are official. Every other Nasdaq row is unverified, including rows where the two libraries agree.

HKEX regular holidays were not fetched as an annual calendar. Closures are secondary-confirmed only where exchange_calendars XHKG and pandas_market_calendars HKEX agree. Early closes exist in exchange_calendars (12:00 HKT) and not in the native HKEX calendar, so those rows are unverified. 2021-04-06 is closed in XHKG and open in native HKEX, with no official notice fetched, so it stays unverified. Morning-only severe-weather sessions that both libraries comment out are not in the dataset. HKEX Severe Weather Trading, in effect from 23 September 2024, is not modeled. HKEX typhoon_closure history starts at 2016-08-02 and is incomplete before 2016: no pre-2016 notice was fetched, and no typhoon notice between 2016 and 2024 is in the dataset unless it was fetched. A missing typhoon row does not mean the market traded that day.

Historical official archives before the pages in the official snapshot were not fetched. A refresh re-checks those URLs and rebuilds the library base. It does not scrape a new December SSE or KRX notice; that notice has to be added to tools/exchange_calendar/official.py after it is read.

Lunch breaks on HKEX, SSE, JPX, and historical KRX are not columns. open_time and close_time are the session open and the session close in exchange-local time. A CME clock that falls on the previous local date is stored as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.
